items.q: Where do the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis take place?
items.qAf: Waar vind die ligafhanklike reaksies van fotosintese plaas?
items.explain: Light is absorbed by chlorophyll in the thylakoid membranes, where ATP and NADPH are made.
items.explainAf: Lig word deur chlorofil in die tilakoïedmembrane geabsorbeer, waar ATP en NADPH gemaak word.

items.q: Which gas is released as a by-product of the light-dependent reactions?
items.qAf: Watter gas word as ’n byproduk van die ligafhanklike reaksies vrygestel?
items.explain: Water is split (photolysis) and oxygen is released.
items.explainAf: Water word gesplits (fotolise) en suurstof word vrygestel.

items.q: The Calvin cycle uses ATP and NADPH from the light reactions to:
items.qAf: Die Calvin-siklus gebruik ATP en NADPH van die ligreaksies om:
optionsAf: koolstofdioksied in suiker vas te lê
items.explain: The Calvin cycle in the stroma fixes CO₂ into glucose using the energy carriers.
items.explainAf: Die Calvin-siklus in die stroma vas CO₂ in glukose vas deur die energiedraers te gebruik.

items.q: At very low light intensity, what limits the rate of photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Wat beperk die tempo van fotosintese by baie lae ligintensiteit?
items.explain: When light is the lowest available factor, increasing other factors does not raise the rate.
items.explainAf: Wanneer lig die laagste beskikbare faktor is, verhoog ander faktore nie die tempo nie.

items.q: What is the effect of very high temperature on the enzymes of photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Wat is die effek van baie hoë temperatuur op die ensieme van fotosintese?
options: They denature and the rate falls
optionsAf: Hulle denatureer en die tempo daal
items.explain: High temperatures denature the enzymes, so the rate drops sharply.
items.explainAf: Hoë temperature denatureer die ensieme, dus daal die tempo skerp.

items.q: Plant A is in light of 500 units. Doubling light to 1000 units doubles the rate, but at 2000 the rate stays the same. What is the limiting factor at 2000 units?
items.qAf: Plant A is in lig van 500 eenhede. Verdubbeling van lig na 1000 eenhede verdubbel die tempo, maar by 2000 bly die tempo dieselfde. Wat is die beperkende faktor by 2000 eenhede?
options: Another factor such as CO₂ or temperature
optionsAf: ’n Ander faktor soos CO₂ of temperatuur
items.explain: Once light is no longer limiting, the rate is limited by another factor.
items.explainAf: Sodra lig nie meer beperkend is nie, word die tempo deur ’n ander faktor beperk.
